item.title: Ohio lawmakers introduce bill to study AI use in government
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio lawmakers have introduced legislation to create a statewide commission tasked with studying the use of artificial intelligence in state and local government and recommending regulations. House Bill 663, introduced Jan. 29 during the 136th General Assembly’s 2025-2026 session, would establish the Artificial Intelligence Study Commission. The panel would review current AI […]
